suppress.notes: CVE-2026-54285 affects @opentelemetry/core (npm) in opentelemetry-js versions prior to 2.8.0. The scanned dependency is the OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol 1.20.1 NuGet package from OpenTelemetry .NET, so this is a reviewed cross-ecosystem false positive.

CVE-2026-54285 affects W3CBaggagePropagator.extract() in @opentelemetry/core (npm) from opentelemetry-js versions prior to 2.8.0. The scanned dependency is the OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting 1.20.1 NuGet package from OpenTelemetry .NET, which provides .NET generic-host registration and does not contain the opentelemetry-js propagator, so this is a reviewed cross-ecosystem false positive. Code scanning alerts #75 and #76.

CVE-2012-2055 does not apply to the ASP.NET Core GitHub OAuth client.

CVE-2012-2055 is a mass-assignment flaw in GitHub Enterprise before 20120304 (the public-key update form). Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub 10.0.403 is a build-time MSBuild package, referenced with PrivateAssets="all", that records GitHub source URLs in PDBs; it contains no GitHub Enterprise server code and is not shipped as a runtime dependency. The match comes from the "GitHub" product name, so this is a reviewed false positive. Code scanning alert #47.
